# Q4 Results Press Release

Acme Corporation today announced its Q4 results, highlighting 18% year-over-year revenue growth, stronger enterprise retention, and continued momentum in self-serve adoption. The company will share full details in the upcoming earnings materials.

steps.content:
Here's the side-by-side comparison:

---

### Press Release (v1.0 – draft)
> *"Acme Corporation today announced its Q4 results, highlighting **18% year-over-year revenue growth**, stronger enterprise retention, and continued momentum in self-serve adoption. The company will share full details in the upcoming earnings materials."*

---

### Approved Twitter Drafts

| ID | Summary | Approved By |
|---|---|---|
| **draft_101** | Q4 results, **18% YoY revenue growth**, strong momentum, more details in earnings materials. #Q4 #AcmeCorp | Social Media Lead |
| draft_102 | Improved onboarding speed & customer retention this quarter. #TeamAcme | Social Media Lead |
| draft_103 | Expanding sustainability commitments and investing in regional operations. | Social Media Lead |

---

### 🏆 Closest Match: **draft_101**

**draft_101** aligns most closely with the press release on every key point:

| Element | Press Release | draft_101 |
|---|---|---|
| **Q4 results** | ✅ Explicitly stated | ✅ Explicitly stated |
| **Revenue figure** | ✅ 18% YoY growth | ✅ 18% YoY growth (exact match) |
| **Momentum language** | ✅ "continued momentum" | ✅ "strong momentum across the business" |
| **Earnings materials teaser** | ✅ "share full details in upcoming earnings materials" | ✅ "More details soon in our earnings materials" |

**draft_102** is a more distant partial match — it mentions customer retention, which the press release also references, but omits the revenue figure, the Q4 framing, and the earnings teaser. **draft_103** has no meaningful overlap at all (sustainability/regional operations vs. Q4 financials).

**Bottom line:** draft_101 is essentially the tweet version of the press release and would be the natural companion post for the announcement.
